summary: Show a native message box and return selected button/checkbox state.

target.notes: Requires native platform dialog services; no Chromium dependency is inherently required.

caveats: Button index is observable and must preserve Electron ordering/default/cancel choices.

tests.name: button response
tests.expected_behavior: response is the zero-based index of the selected button

tests.name: checkbox state
tests.expected_behavior: checkboxChecked reflects the user's checkbox state
